profile:
COMPANY NAME: Expion360
INDUSTRY: Energy Storage / Automotive & Marine Batteries
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Premium LiFePO4 lithium batteries, solar power systems, chargers, inverters, and accessories designed for off-grid, RV, marine, and industrial applications.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: RV owners, overland adventurers, marine enthusiasts, golf cart users, and industrial off-grid power users.
PRICING MODEL: Direct-to-consumer retail (with periodic sales/discounts)
KEY FEATURES:
- 12-year warranty on LiFePO4 batteries
- UL1973 compliant safety standards
- Bluetooth-enabled battery monitoring via SmartTalk App
- Wide range of voltage options including 12V and 48V systems
- Integrated solar charging and inverter solutions
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: U.S.-based engineering, industry-leading reliability, and unmatched longevity for heavy-duty applications.
TONE & POSITIONING: Premium / Adventure-focused / Trustworthy
